messages:
oncall-bot: INCIDENT: Elevated function/tool invocation errors (502/timeout) across regions. Auto-paging #eng-platform oncall.

alex: I'm on it — seeing tool-proxy latency spike and error rate up ~5x. Correlated with a surge in external agent calls.

maria: Customer-facing: chat actions that trigger tool calls are failing intermittently; ~10% of sessions hitting structured-output/tool-call errors. Getting CS alerts.

dan: Triage: backend queueing + downstream timeouts. Recommend emergency mitigations: 1) global rate-limit on tool calls (50%) 2) disable external function invocation for free and trial tiers 3) force text-only fallback / prune structured output fields for streaming.

ryan: Support: marking as P1, collecting ticket IDs. We need a short comms line to send to affected customers.

alex: Applying mitigations now. Patch payload I'm pushing:

```json
{
  "feature.external_invokes.enabled": false,
  "rate_limits.tool_calls.global": "50%",
  "response.mode.prefer_text_only": true
}
```

sam: Heads-up: make sure SDKs receive clear error codes (429/503) so apps can fallback gracefully.

dan: Flip done for us-east and eu-west. Watching metrics (function_exec_errors, proxy_latency).

oncall-bot: METRIC: function_exec_errors (us-east) 12% -> 3% after caps in 2m. Latency improved ~220ms -> ~120ms.

maria: Can we preserve structured output shape but remove tool invocation payloads? i.e., keep user-visible text, but strip "function_call" blocks to avoid downstream proxy hits.

sam: Alternative: keep structured JSON but set `function_call` to null and append fallback_text. That keeps contract for SDKs.

alex: Good idea. For faster rollback risk-reduction: keep structured output but prune tool payloads. I'll update config.

```bash
# deploy config update
deployctl set structured_output.mode=prune --scope=prod --target=all
deployctl set feature.external_invokes.free_tier=off
deployctl set rate_limits.tool_calls.global=50%
```

ryan: Draft customer message: "We're experiencing degraded behavior in tool-enabled features. We've temporarily restricted external tool invocations and adjusted response formats to stabilize service. You may see fallbacks to text-only responses. We're working on a full restore and will update within 30 minutes. No user data was lost." Approve?

maria: Approve. Add fallback tip: set `fallback: text_only` in SDK config for critical paths.

alex: Rolling that comms now to affected orgs and status page. Posting in #status-updates.

oncall-bot: ACTION: @dan assigned for active watch (30m). @oncall-night paged for handoff in 25m.

dan: Staying on the bridge. I'll escalate if errors rebound.

oncall-night: Acknowledged — will take over watch and coordinate next steps.

oncall-bot: STATUS: mitigations reduced error rate to baseline. Plan: controlled canary re-enable of external invokes for paid tiers in 20m, monitor 5m window, then stagger re-enable. Postmortem & RCA to be opened after stabilization.

alex: I'll post an incident summary and open the postmortem. Leaving thread for oncall-night.

oncall-bot: INCIDENT NOTE: temporary feature restrictions applied; customer comms sent; oncall handoff complete.
